questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. Rohan exercised and ate a lot, lest he should not be weak .
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.
Rohan exercised and ate a lot, lest he should not be weak.

options.text: lest he would not be weak
options.html: lest he would not be weak

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4.
 
Key Points
  • The structure "lest + subject + should" is used to express a fear or a precaution, and "should" is the correct form in this context.
  • The phrase "lest he should be weak" correctly follows this construction, conveying that Rohan took actions to prevent weakness.
  • The other options (such as "lest he would be weak" or "lest he would not be weak") are incorrect because they do not align with the grammatical structure of "lest".
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
 
Correct Sentence: "Rohan exercised and ate a lot, lest he should be weak."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "lest he should not weak" – The phrase "should not weak" is grammatically incorrect because "weak" is an adjective, not a verb.
  • Option 2: "lest he would be weak" – The use of "would" is incorrect after "lest"; "should" is the appropriate modal verb in this context.
  • Option 3: "lest he would not be weak" – "would" is unnecessary and incorrect here as "should" is used after "lest".

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence. Despite his annoyance , Rahul knew that rushing the delicate process would only lead to mistakes.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.
Despite his annoyance, Rahul knew that rushing the delicate process would only lead to mistakes.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Serenity.

Key Points

  • The word "annoyance" means a feeling of irritation or displeasure. (चिड़चिड़ापन)
    • Example: His constant interruptions were a source of annoyance for everyone.
  • "Serenity" refers to a state of being calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांति)
    • Example: The serenity of the mountain landscape brought a sense of peace to her mind.
  • Hence, we can infer that the opposite of 'annoyance' is 'serenity'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Serenity.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Susceptibility (संवेदनशीलता): The state of being likely to be influenced or harmed by something.
    • Example: His susceptibility to colds increased during the winter months.
  • Absurdity (मूर्खता): The quality or state of being ridiculous or wildly unreasonable.
    • Example: The absurdity of his argument was evident to everyone in the room.
  • Gnawer (कुतरने वाला): An animal that gnaws, typically a rodent.
    • Example: The gnawer had chewed through the wooden beams in the attic.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that means the same as the underlined group of words to fill in the blank. Most of the rivers dry up during the summer season, but the Ganga is full of water round the year because it is ________.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that means the same as the underlined group of words to fill in the blank.

Most of the rivers dry up during the summer season, but the Ganga is full of water round the year because it is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'perennial'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "perennial" means lasting or existing for a long or apparently infinite time; enduring or continually recurring. (अनवरत)
  • A river that flows continuously throughout the year regardless of the season is considered perennial.
  • The other options: "biennial," "biannual," and "annual" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

Complete Sentence: Most of the rivers dry up during the summer season, but the Ganga is full of water round the year because it is perennial.

Additional Information
  • Biennial (द्विवार्षिक): means taking place every other year.
  • Biannual (अर्धवार्षिक): means occurring twice a year.
  • Annual (वार्षिक): means occurring once every year.

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence. A. So I am not very sure B. I have a driving license C. Of myself reaching home safely D. But no real driving experience
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
A. So I am not very sure
B. I have a driving license
C. Of myself reaching home safely
D. But no real driving experience
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option (3) i.e. BDAC
Key Points
  • The sentence begins with the subject "I have a driving license," which is correctly indicated by part (B). 
  • Following the subject, "but no real driving experience," (BD) continues the logical sequence, making it clear that despite having a license, there is no experience.
  • The next part, "so I am not very sure," starts the explanation about the uncertainty, indicated by (A).
  • Ending with "of myself reaching home safely" (C) completes the sentence by stating the concern about reaching home safely.
Therefore, the correct answer is BDAC.
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1 (BCAD): This option starts with "I have a driving license of myself reaching home safely," which makes the sentence incomplete and does not make sense logically.
  • Option 2 (BDCA): This option starts with "I have a driving license but no real driving experience of myself reaching home safely," which makes the sentence incorrect as the explanation of uncertainty is missing.
  • Option 4 (CABD): This option starts with "of myself reaching home safely so I am not very sure I have a driving license," which creates a fragmented and confusing sentence structure.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. Can you compose an inspiring poem?
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Can you compose an inspiring poem?

options.text: Can an inspiring poem be composed?
options.html: Can an inspiring poem be composed?

options.text: An inspiring poem can be composed by you.
options.html: An inspiring poem can be composed by you.

options.text: Can an inspiring poem be composed by you?
options.html: Can an inspiring poem be composed by you?

options.text: Can an inspiring poem by you composed?
options.html: Can an inspiring poem by you composed?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 3.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "Can you compose an inspiring poem?"
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "an inspiring poem" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "compose" to "be composed" (passive infinitive form).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "you."
  • Ensure the question structure remains intact by placing the auxiliary verb "can" at the beginning.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.
 
Correct Sentence: "Can an inspiring poem be composed by you?"
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "Can an inspiring poem be composed?" – This sentence is in passive voice but lacks the agent "by you."
  • Option 2: "An inspiring poem can be composed by you." – This is a passive voice sentence but not in question form.
  • Option 4: "Can an inspiring poem by you composed?" – This sentence is grammatically incorrect.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given word. Pugnacious

  • "Waspish" refers to someone who is readily expressing anger or irritation. (क्रोधी)

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Waspish.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Condone

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Solitude (एकांत): The state of being alone.

questions.question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice. The tutor was not teaching the student.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
The tutor was not teaching the student.

options.text: The student was not taught by the tutor.

questions.question: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence. (P) dreams provide an escape (Q) where reality is suspended (R) into a world (O) of endless possibilities
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence.
(P) dreams provide an escape
(Q) where reality is suspended
(R) into a world
(O) of endless possibilities
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. PROQ
Key Points
  • The sentence begins with part (P) which starts the idea "dreams provide an escape," giving a clear introduction to the subject of the sentence.
  • Next, part (R) follows logically with "into a world," describing where this escape leads.
  • Part (O) continues the thought with "of endless possibilities," completing the image of the world dreams offer.
  • Ending with part (Q), which specifies "where reality is suspended," finalizing the context and nature of the escape described in the sentence.
Therefore, the correct answer is PROQ.
Additional Information
  • Option 1 (OPQR): This option starts with "dreams provide an escape," but the sentence structure gets disrupted as it places "into a world" prematurely before the phrase "of endless possibilities," making it unclear.
  • Option 3 (OQRP): This sequence introduces "dreams provide an escape" correctly, but it places "where reality is suspended" too early, causing an awkward flow and losing the natural progression of ideas.
  • Option 4 (RPOQ): Starting with "into a world" creates a fragmented structure and lacks context, making the sentence grammatically incorrect and confusing.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word. Dogmatic

    • Example: His dogmatic insistence on his own view was very frustrating for the team.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. Kilter
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
Kilter
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: Option (1) i.e. Order.

Key Points 

  • The word "Kilter" means a proper or usual state or condition; when something is functioning or arranged in the right way. (संतुलन / ठीक स्थिति)
    • Example: After the power outage, everything in the office was out of kilter for a few hours.
  • "Order" refers to a state in which everything is arranged properly or functions correctly. (व्यवस्था / क्रम)
    • Example: The files are now in perfect order after hours of organizing.
  • Hence, both 'Kilter' and 'Order' refer to a state of balance or correct arrangement, making them synonyms.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Order.


Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • Disrepair (जीर्ण अवस्था / टूट-फूट की स्थिति): The state of needing repair; not in good condition.
    • Example: The old mansion had fallen into disrepair after years of neglect.
  • Anarchy (अराजकता): A state of disorder due to absence or disregard of authority or laws.
    • Example: After the government collapsed, the country descended into anarchy.
  • Shambles (अव्यवस्था / गड़बड़ स्थिति): A state of total disorder or chaos.
    • Example: The room was a complete shambles after the party.

questions.question: The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. We were on the way to the party/ suddenly, there/ will a heavy downpour.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
